--- a/backend/services/contact_manager.py
+++ b/backend/services/contact_manager.py
@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
 from typing import Optional, Dict, Any, List
 from backend.data.crud import update_contact, get_contact_by_id
+from backend.data.crud import get_contact_by_external_id
 from backend.data.models import Contact
 from backend.services.memory_extractor import extract_facts_from_message
 from backend.tools.memory_tools import store_fact_in_memory
@@ -15,7 +16,7 @@ class ContactManager:
         self._memory_extractor = memory_extractor or extract_facts_from_message
         self._memory_tools = memory_tools or store_fact_in_memory
 
-    def process_confirmed_contact_fact(self, contact_id: int, fact_text: str, source: str = "chat") -> bool:
+    def process_confirmed_contact_fact(self, contact_id: int, fact_text: str, source: str = "chat", external_id: Optional[str] = None) -> bool:
         """
         Persist a confirmed fact about an existing contact.
         
         If the contact is already in the address book, update the contact record.
         Otherwise, fall back to memory-only storage.
         """
-        contact = get_contact_by_id(contact_id)
+        contact = get_contact_by_id(contact_id) if contact_id else get_contact_by_external_id(external_id) if external_id else None
         if contact is None:
             # Contact not found in address book; store in memory only
             self._memory_tools(contact_id, fact_text, source)
             return False
         
         # Contact exists in address book; persist the fact
         update_contact(contact_id, {"notes": contact.notes + "\n" + fact_text if contact.notes else fact_text})
         return True
